issues.description: Method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): The problem statement (text and UML) declares getTotalNumberOfStudents() as a public method (UML shows +getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int and the task text asks for a public method). The solution implementation declares the method with protected visibility (protected int getTotalNumberOfStudents()). The template only contains a TODO for this method and does not provide a signature. This visibility mismatch between the problem specification and the solution can confuse students about the intended API and may cause tests or external callers to be unable to access the method as specified in the UML.
issues.suggestedFix: Make getTotalNumberOfStudents() public to match the problem statement and UML. Change the solution method signature to 'public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() { ... }'. Update the template (or its TODO comment) to indicate the method should be public so students implement the same visibility.
